reuse.why: Adds one guard and calls it from each of the five provider link functions; the tree has no shared link pipeline to hook into, and the guard does not live in the existing link.ts helper module.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; only the one-line guard call is repeated at the five entry points.

placement.why: Server accounts layer is right, but link-specific helpers such as findOrCreateBank live in accounts/link.ts, while the new guard sits at the top of app.ts between the param type and the handler types.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five call sites and handler-level tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and covered by tests; a new provider has to remember to call the guard, a pattern the duplicated link bodies already impose.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, called by all five link* handlers
